text.en: Explain how you would reduce noise in a sensor signal before it reaches a microcontroller.
text.fil: Ipaliwanag kung paano mo babawasan ang noise sa signal ng isang sensor bago ito umabot sa microcontroller.

criteria.name: Valid techniques
criteria.description: Names correct hardware and software noise-reduction techniques.
key_points: uses a low-pass or RC filter
uses shielding, grounding or short wiring

5: I would add an RC low-pass filter before the ADC, use shielded twisted-pair cable with a single ground point, and apply a moving average or median filter in firmware.
3: I would use a filter and maybe average the readings.
1: I would use a better sensor.

criteria.correction: Mention at least one hardware method, such as an RC filter or shielding, and one software method, such as averaging.

criteria.name: Explains why
criteria.description: Explains why the technique works or how to choose its values.
key_points: relates to the sampling rate or signal bandwidth

5: I would choose the cutoff above the sensor's useful bandwidth but well below half the sampling rate, so I keep the signal while avoiding aliasing.
3: The filter removes the high-frequency part of the signal.

criteria.correction: Explain why your method works, for example how you choose the filter's cutoff frequency.

text.en: What do you consider when designing a printed circuit board?
text.fil: Ano ang mga isinasaalang-alang mo kapag nagdidisenyo ng printed circuit board?

criteria.name: Design considerations
criteria.description: Covers trace width, grounding, component placement and manufacturability.

5: I size traces for the current they carry, use a solid ground plane, place decoupling capacitors close to each IC's power pins, keep high-speed traces short, and run the manufacturer's design rule check.
3: I make sure the traces are connected properly and the board is not too big.

criteria.correction: Mention specific rules: trace width for current, a ground plane, decoupling capacitors, and the design rule check.

criteria.name: Hands-on experience
criteria.description: References a board they designed and the tool used.
key_points: names a PCB tool such as KiCad or Altium

5: In KiCad I designed a two-layer board for a power supply project, had it fabricated, and fixed a footprint error in the second revision.
3: I have used KiCad in our laboratory class.
1: I have not really made one.

criteria.correction: Mention the tool you used and a board you actually designed, including what you learned from it.
